answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing a cryptographic hash function can effectively thwart fake-identity attacks. Each agent's unique digital signature, akin to a gentle zephyr, is generated by hashing its public key and timestamp. This ensures that any attempt to replicate an agent's signature would create a ripple effect, immediately detecting the duplication. An attacker attempting to create multiple identities would embark on a voyage of duplicating signatures, only to be swiftly identified and penalized, thereby maintaining the integrity of the network.
